newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian union leader shot dead - news agency.
newsitem.headline: Indian union leader shot dead - news agency.

text.p: Indian trade union leader Datta Samant was killed by unidentified gunmen on Thursday, the Press Trust of India news agency said.
Earlier police said Samant was shot while travelling in a car in a Bombay suburb but did not give any details.
Police officials would not confirm Samant was dead.
"He was fired upon. We have no other details," one official told Reuters.
PTI said Samant was shot by assailants riding in a motor-rickshaw. "Samant was immediately rushed to hospital...but succumbed to bullet injuries," PTI said.
